'''Desperation's Refuge''' was a small encampment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veroleem]], which was operated by former [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of the [[Cult of Veroleem]] that had escaped from their masters and formed a resistance movement. The encampment was constituted of a number of tents, which were capable of being packed up at a moment's notice, to relocate the settement elsewhere. Despite the efforts of the enforcers and [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] of the Cult of Veroleem to find Desperation's Refuge, the township's mobile nature ensured that camp always eluded the cult's clutches.<ref name="TUR" />
